changes.old: Close shot at a public square in 1907, an anonymous clerk holds a blank calendar sheet beside a wooden house sketch, gentle window light
changes.new: Close shot inside a plain 1907 relief office, one elderly clerk's weathered hands in dark wool sleeves pin a completely blank calendar leaf to a bare wooden notice board, a plaster wall and one tall window behind, soft daylight

changes.old: Wide shot on a San Francisco public square in June 1907, one fully grown resident with a mature face in a plain early-1900s coat and brimmed hat places a hand on the doorway of a small stationary wooden relief cottage among a row of cottages, muted overcast light
changes.new: Medium close shot beside a small wooden relief cottage in a 1907 American camp, one tall grey-haired middle-aged resident with sideburns in a plain dark wool coat places one hand on the cottage's simple plank doorway, its low roof and timber wall filling the background, bare earth at his feet, overcast daylight

changes.old: Medium shot at a public square in 1907, an anonymous resident holds an unmarked folded paper beside a plain wooden house, soft grey daylight
changes.new: Close shot inside a small 1907 wooden relief cottage, one adult resident's weathered hands in plain wool sleeves place a closed cloth coin purse on a completely blank paper sheet on a rough wooden table, bare timber wall behind, soft window daylight

changes.old: Close shot at a 1913 archive desk, an anonymous clerk opens an unmarked survey volume beside a simple cottage drawing, dim lamp light
changes.new: Medium close shot inside a plain 1913 survey office, one elderly researcher with grey hair and a dark high-collared coat opens a thick unlettered bound book on a bare wooden desk, a plain plaster wall behind, soft daylight through one tall window

changes.old: Wide shot at a public square in 1907, an anonymous clerk turns over two blank paper forms, diffuse morning light
changes.new: Close shot on a rough wooden desk inside a plain 1907 relief office, one adult clerk's weathered hands in dark wool sleeves hold two completely blank paper slips apart above a closed cloth coin purse, bare plaster wall beyond, soft window daylight

changes.old: Medium shot at a public square in 1907, an anonymous adult sets coins beside a blank moving-company slip, soft overcast light
changes.new: Close shot at the low wooden doorstep of a 1907 relief cottage, a closed cloth coin purse lies on bare ground while one weathered adult hand in a dark wool sleeve hovers beside it, the cottage's plank door fills the background, soft overcast daylight
